item.title: Loyalty Is Dead in Silicon Valley
item.description: Founders used to be wedded to their companies. Now, anyone can be lured away for the right price.

item.title: ICE and CBP’s Face-Recognition App Can’t Actually Verify Who People Are
item.description: ICE has used Mobile Fortify to identify immigrants and citizens alike over 100,000 times, by one estimate. It wasn't built to work like that—and only got approved after DHS abandoned its own privacy rules.

item.title: Hollywood Is Losing Audiences to AI Fatigue
item.description: Entertainment about or made with artificial intelligence has been missing the mark with viewers over the past year.

item.title: A New AI Math Startup Just Cracked 4 Previously Unsolved Problems
item.description: Axiom says its AI found solutions to several long-standing math problems, a sign of the technology’s steadily advancing reasoning capabilities.

item.title: Mistral's New Ultra-Fast Translation Model Gives Big AI Labs a Run for Their Money
item.description: “Too many GPUs makes you lazy,” says the French startup’s vice president of science operations, as the company carves out a different path than the major US AI companies.

item.title: AI Bots Are Now a Significant Source of Web Traffic
item.description: New data shows AI bots pushing deeper into the web, prompting publishers to roll out more aggressive defenses.

item.title: HHS Is Making an AI Tool to Create Hypotheses About Vaccine Injury Claims
item.description: Experts worry Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s Health Department will use an internal AI tool to analyze vaccine injury claims in a way that furthers his anti-vaccine agenda.

item.title: I Infiltrated Moltbook, the AI-Only Social Network Where Humans Aren’t Allowed
item.description: I went undercover on Moltbook and loved role-playing as a conscious bot. But rather than a novel breakthrough, the AI-only site is a crude rehashing of sci-fi fantasies.

item.title: ‘Fallout’ Producer Jonathan Nolan on AI: ‘We’re in Such a Frothy Moment’
item.description: The Westworld showrunner thinks AI will be good for burgeoning filmmakers, but not for Hollywood blockbusters.

item.title: Elon Musk Is Rolling xAI Into SpaceX—Creating the World’s Most Valuable Private Company
item.description: By fusing SpaceX and xAI—which acquired X last year—Elon Musk tightens his grip over technologies that shape national security, social media, and artificial intelligence.
